moments.title: Joni Mitchell turns 83
moments.blurb: Legendary Canadian-American singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell, known for hits like 'Big Yellow Taxi' and 'Both Sides Now', celebrates her 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Folk Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Joni Mitchell! From 'Big Yellow Taxi' to 'Both Sides Now', her songwriting changed music forever. What's your favourite Joni track?

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: Still sounding as fresh today as they did in the 60s and 70s. Raising a glass to Joni Mitchell on her 83rd birthday!

moments.title: Lorde celebrates her 30th birthday
moments.blurb: New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde, who rose to fame with her breakthrough hit 'Royals', turns 30 today.

angles.name: Pop Prodigy
angles.copy: Can you believe Lorde is 30 today?! From 'Royals' to 'Solar Power', she's been a game-changer since day one. What's your top Lorde song?

angles.name: Decade of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 30th to Lorde! Feeling old yet? Her debut 'Royals' was a decade ago and still sounds incredible.

moments.title: Strictly Week 7 Live Show
moments.blurb: Tonight, the remaining couples on Strictly Come Dancing took to the ballroom for Week 7 performances, with Dani Dyer and Nikita Kuzmin topping the leaderboard with 36 points.

angles.name: Leaderboard Topper
angles.copy: Dani Dyer and Nikita Kuzmin smashed it on Strictly tonight, taking the top spot! Who impressed you most in Week 7?

angles.name: Week 7 Reactions
angles.copy: That was Week 7 of Strictly! Some incredible dances tonight, plus Jaime Winstone had a bye due to injury. All eyes on the results tomorrow!

moments.title: Premier League Saturday Results
moments.blurb: Today's Premier League action saw Leeds beat Tottenham 1-0, Arsenal win 1-0 against Hull, and Fulham draw 1-1 with Newcastle. Nottingham Forest play Manchester City later.

angles.name: Full Time Scores
angles.copy: Premier League FT: Leeds 1-0 Tottenham, Arsenal 1-0 Hull, Fulham 1-1 Newcastle. Big results already today! Who are you backing in the late kick-off?

angles.name: Match Day Update
angles.copy: Another busy Saturday in the Premier League! How did your team get on today?

moments.title: Remembrance Sunday Across the UK
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, November 8, marks Remembrance Sunday, with the National Service of Remembrance taking place at the Cenotaph in Whitehall, London at 11am, alongside countless local services nationwide.

angles.name: National Remembrance
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we observe Remembrance Sunday. Join us in pausing at 11am to honour the service and sacrifice of our Armed Forces, past and present. #RemembranceSunday

angles.name: Local Services
angles.copy: Many communities across the UK will hold local services tomorrow for Remembrance Sunday. Check with your local council for details on how you can pay your respects.

moments.title: Gordon Ramsay turns 60
moments.blurb: Celebrity chef and TV personality Gordon Ramsay, born in Johnstone, Scotland, celebrates his 60th birthday tomorrow, November 8.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chef
angles.copy: He's not just a chef, he's a national treasure! Gordon Ramsay turns 60 tomorrow. What's your favourite Ramsay TV moment?

angles.name: Scottish Icon
angles.copy: Scotland's very own, Gordon Ramsay, hits the big 6-0 tomorrow! Wishing the fiery chef a fantastic birthday.

moments.title: Sunday Premier League Games
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, Premier League action continues with Brighton v Brentford, Crystal Palace v Liverpool, Ipswich v Bournemouth, Sunderland v Chelsea (all 2pm GMT), and Manchester United v Aston Villa (4:30pm GMT).

angles.name: Super Sunday Football
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive Sunday of Premier League football! Which fixture are you most looking forward to tomorrow?

angles.name: Match Predictions
angles.copy: Sunday's Premier League line-up is looking tasty! Give us your score predictions for tomorrow's games.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Week 7 Results
moments.blurb: After tonight's performances, one couple will be eliminated from Strictly Come Dancing in tomorrow's Week 7 results show.

angles.name: Elimination Anticipation
angles.copy: Who's in the dance-off? Who's going home? All will be revealed in tomorrow's Strictly Come Dancing results show!

angles.name: Public Vote
angles.copy: The public vote is crucial after tonight's Strictly performances! Tune in tomorrow to see who makes it through to Week 8.

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Launch
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! kicks off on Monday, November 16, at 9pm on ITV1, with Ant & Dec returning to host from Australia.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is ON! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! returns Monday 16th November on ITV1. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle?

angles.name: Ant & Dec Return
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are back in Australia for I'm A Celeb! The new series starts Monday 16th November. Ready for those Bushtucker Trials?

moments.title: Marylebone Christmas Lights Switch-On
moments.blurb: Marylebone Village will switch on its Christmas lights on Wednesday, November 11, with festivities running from 3pm to 8pm and the lights illuminating at 6pm.

angles.name: Marylebone Sparkles
angles.copy: Get ready for festive cheer! Marylebone Village switches on its Christmas lights this Wednesday, November 11, with celebrations from 3pm!

angles.name: Festive London
angles.copy: Wednesday night, Marylebone Village lights up for Christmas! Expect stalls, entertainment, and that magical switch-on moment at 6pm.

moments.title: Covent Garden Christmas Lights Switch-On
moments.blurb: Covent Garden will host its annual Christmas lights switch-on event on Thursday, November 12, featuring over 300,000 sparkling lights and a British-grown Christmas tree.

angles.name: Covent Garden Glow
angles.copy: Covent Garden's iconic Christmas lights switch on this Thursday, November 12! Expect pure magic with 300,000 lights and the return of the giant tree.

angles.name: Festive Theatre
angles.copy: The 'Theatre of Christmas' returns to Covent Garden this Thursday for the lights switch-on. Live performances and festive feasting await!

moments.title: Blue Lights Season 4 Premieres
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Belfast police drama 'Blue Lights' returns for its fourth season on BritBox this Thursday, November 12, with new episodes weekly.

angles.name: Belfast Drama Returns
angles.copy: Fans rejoice! 'Blue Lights' Season 4 premieres this Thursday on BritBox. Ready to dive back into the streets of Belfast?

angles.name: New British Drama
angles.copy: Looking for your next TV obsession? 'Blue Lights' Season 4 starts Thursday, November 12. Don't miss the gripping return to Blackthorn Station.
